---
title: "AI-Assisted Federal Survey Harmonization"
---

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
This report presents a systematic analysis of harmonization potential across 47 Census Bureau demographic survey instruments containing approximately 7,000 questions. Using multi-model AI-assisted methods, the research identifies cross-survey integration opportunities, characterizes harmonization barriers, and produces actionable inventories of bridge variables for data enrichment.

For methodology details, see the companion [Methodology Document](../methodology/). For validation metrics, see the companion [TEVV Document](../tevv/).
:::
